skill.name: wan-2-7
skill.description: Guides users through generating short text-to-video clips with Wan 2.7 on RunComfy. It documents model selection, prompt structure, CLI inputs, audio URL use, output settings, and known limits.
skill.summary: Generate Wan 2.7 text-to-video clips on RunComfy with guided prompts and CLI settings.
skill.author: runcomfy-com

security_audit.summary: The skill is documentation-driven and I found no prompt injection or malicious intent. Confirmed risks are expected external CLI execution and documented RunComfy network calls; most static hits are Markdown backtick false positives.

remediation.issue: External CLI commands are central to the skill workflow.
remediation.suggestion: Require user confirmation before running npm, npx, runcomfy login, or runcomfy run commands, and show the exact command first.

remediation.issue: Prompts, audio URLs, and media references are sent to RunComfy.
remediation.suggestion: Warn users not to submit secrets, private recordings, internal URLs, or confidential media through the hosted model API.

remediation.issue: Authentication tokens may be stored by the RunComfy CLI.
remediation.suggestion: Keep the token path and 0600 permission requirement documented, and recommend RUNCOMFY_TOKEN for CI or temporary environments.

remediation.issue: Placeholder paths and URLs can be mistaken for literal values.
remediation.suggestion: State that placeholder audio URLs and output directories must be replaced with trusted user-controlled values.

content.value_statement: Creating short AI videos with exact model settings can be slow and error-prone. This skill guides Wan 2.7 prompts, CLI inputs, audio URLs, and output choices.
actual_capabilities: Explains when to choose Wan 2.7 instead of related video models.
Documents the RunComfy text-to-video endpoint and supported input fields.
Provides CLI invocation patterns for default, lip-sync, and literal-control runs.
Guides prompt writing for camera motion, action focus, negatives, and seed reuse.
Lists duration, resolution, aspect ratio, audio, and reference media limits.
limitations: Requires the RunComfy CLI and a RunComfy account or token.
Outputs are limited to the model constraints documented by RunComfy.
The skill does not create videos without calling the external RunComfy service.
Audio URLs must meet the documented format, duration, and size limits.

use_cases.title: Create Product Showcase Clips
use_cases.description: Build short 1080p product videos with clear camera motion, lighting, and negative prompts.

use_cases.title: Produce Lip-Synced Spokesperson Videos
use_cases.description: Use a prepared audio URL to generate short spokesperson clips for ads or announcements.

use_cases.title: Prototype Vertical Social Videos
use_cases.description: Generate 9:16 motion concepts with focused action, reusable seeds, and fast prompt iteration.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Basic Video
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for a simple text-to-video request.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a 5 second Wan 2.7 video on RunComfy from this idea: [describe the scene]. Use 1080p and 16:9.

prompt_templates.title: Control Camera and Motion
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt for a shot with clear movement and composition.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Wan 2.7 prompt for [subject]. Include camera angle, camera movement, lighting, one main action, and a negative prompt.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Lip-Sync Run
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for a short video driven by an audio file.
prompt_templates.prompt: Set up a Wan 2.7 lip-sync video using this audio URL: [audio URL]. Match duration, aspect ratio, prompt, and negative prompt.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Model Fit and Settings
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow for choosing Wan 2.7 or another RunComfy model.
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate whether Wan 2.7 is the right model for this video brief: [brief]. Recommend settings, limits, and any better sibling model.

output_examples.input: A product video for a premium watch on a marble surface.
output_examples.output: The skill would produce a focused Wan 2.7 plan with studio lighting, slow camera push-in, 1080p output, and targeted negative prompts.

output_examples.input: A vertical spokesperson clip with a prepared voiceover file.
output_examples.output: The skill would guide a 9:16 lip-sync run, check audio duration limits, and include a prompt matching mouth movement and camera framing.

output_examples.input: A prompt that must stay literal for brand compliance.
output_examples.output: The skill would recommend disabling prompt expansion and using a concise negative prompt for subtitles, flicker, watermarks, and distorted details.

best_practices: Use one main action per clip and describe camera movement early.
Keep audio files within the documented duration, size, and format limits.
Reuse seeds for controlled variants and change seeds for visual variety.
anti_patterns: Do not submit vague static descriptions when visible motion is required.
Do not rely on broad negative prompts such as bad quality or bad colors.
Do not include secrets or private media URLs in prompts sent to external services.

faq.question: What does this skill help me create?
faq.answer: It helps create short Wan 2.7 text-to-video clips through the RunComfy CLI.

faq.question: Does it support lip-sync video?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents use of audio_url for WAV or MP3 tracks that meet the model limits.

faq.question: Does it run locally only?
faq.answer: No. It uses the local RunComfy CLI to call the hosted RunComfy Model API.

faq.question: What resolution can I request?
faq.answer: The documented options are 720p and 1080p, with 1080p used as the default.

faq.question: Can I generate longer videos?
faq.answer: Wan 2.7 clips are capped at 15 seconds, so longer stories require multiple clips.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, or Claude Code use this skill?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
